headline.en: UNI breaks below treasury burn anchor as net +2% inflation exposes buyback narrative failure
headline.zh: UNI跌破国库销毁锚定价，净通胀率+2%暴露回购叙事失效

keyChanges.en: Price dropped 17.64% in 7 days to $5.78, now 3% below treasury's $5.96 burn anchor—market says DAO overpaid
keyChanges.zh: 价格7日暴跌17.64%至5.78美元，较国库5.96美元销毁锚定价低3%——市场认为DAO买贵了

keyChanges.en: TVL contracted 8.02% to $3.29B, signaling reduced protocol usage amid broader deleveraging
keyChanges.zh: TVL收缩8.02%至32.9亿美元，协议使用量下降反映更广泛去杠杆

keyChanges.en: Net emission remains +17.87M UNI/year (+2.02% inflation): $12.29M annual buyback only burns 2.13M vs 20M emission
keyChanges.zh: 净释放量仍为+1787万UNI/年(+2.02%通胀)：年度回购1229万美元仅销毁213万枚，远低于2000万释放量

contrarianObservation.en: Trading 3% below treasury's own burn price ($5.96) with net inflation of only 2.02% may be an overshoot—a modest 20% protocol revenue increase (achievable in bull markets) would cut net inflation to ~1.6%, yet the market prices in zero growth despite Uniswap's dominant DEX position
contrarianObservation.zh: 当前价格较国库销毁价(5.96美元)低3%且净通胀率仅2.02%，可能是超跌——协议收入若提升20%(牛市中可实现)即可将净通胀降至约1.6%，但市场却对Uniswap的DEX主导地位定价为零增长

watchNext.en: Whether price holds $5.50 support (institutional accumulation zone floor)
watchNext.zh: 价格能否守住5.50美元支撑位(机构建仓区间下沿)

watchNext.en: Any governance activity on real-yield RFC—this would fundamentally change UNI from reflexive to cash-flow asset
watchNext.zh: 实际收益RFC的治理动态——这将从根本上改变UNI从反身性代币到现金流资产的属性

watchNext.en: Weekly protocol revenue trend: need sustained >$1.5M to materially improve burn-to-emission ratio
watchNext.zh: 协议周收入趋势：需持续>150万美元才能实质改善销毁-释放比

fullReasoning.en: UNI is in technical breakdown, trading below the DAO's own $5.96 burn anchor after a brutal 17.64% weekly decline. The market is rejecting the treasury's valuation. More critically, the net inflation math exposes the flaw: despite buyback-burn, UNI still emits a net +17.87M tokens annually (+2.02% inflation) because $12.29M in annual buybacks only offsets 2.13M of the 20M emission at current prices. This is why bulls capitulate—the deflationary narrative is false at these levels. TVL down 8% in a week confirms rotations out. With no active real-yield governance proposal, UNI remains a reflexive governance token with negative carry from inflation. The setup is bearish on fundamentals. However, confidence is medium not high because we're approaching institutional accumulation floors ($4-7 range), funding is neutral (no crowded short), and modest protocol revenue growth would materially cut net inflation. Without a catalyst though, gravity wins near-term.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI正处于技术性崩溃，在7日暴跌17.64%后跌破DAO自己的5.96美元销毁锚定价。市场正在否定国库的估值判断。更关键的是净通胀数学暴露了机制缺陷：尽管有回购销毁，UNI仍年净释放+1787万枚代币(+2.02%通胀)，因为按当前价格年度回购1229万美元仅能抵消2000万释放量中的213万枚。这正是多头投降的原因——在当前价位通缩叙事是虚假的。TVL单周下跌8%确认资金外流。在没有实际收益治理提案的情况下，UNI仍是带有通胀负收益的反身性治理代币。基本面偏空。但信心定为中等而非高度，因为价格正接近机构建仓区间(4-7美元)，资金费率中性(无拥挤空头)，且协议收入温和增长即可显著降低净通胀。但缺乏催化剂的情况下，短期重力占优。
